question.en: Does Florida Have a State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program (SPAP) in 2026?
question.es: ¿Florida tiene un Programa Estatal de Asistencia Farmaceutica (SPAP) en 2026?

shortAnswer.en: It depends. Florida's SPAP closed in 1991; Extra Help and MSPs fill the gap.
shortAnswer.es: Depende. El SPAP de Florida cerro en 1991; Extra Help y los MSP llenan el vacio.

fullAnswer.en: It depends on what you need. Florida's official State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program (SPAP), administered through the Florida Comprehensive Health Association, closed to new enrollees in 1991 and is not accessible to most residents today. Florida seniors and people with disabilities have three primary pathways for prescription drug cost relief in 2026: Medicare Extra Help (the federal Low Income Subsidy), Medicare Savings Programs (QMB, SLMB, and QI), and the Florida Rx Card discount program. Florida SHINE counselors at 1-800-963-5337 provide free, unbiased help navigating all options.
fullAnswer.es: Depende de lo que necesite. El Programa Estatal de Asistencia Farmaceutica (SPAP) oficial de Florida, administrado a traves de la Asociacion de Salud Integral de Florida, cerro para nuevos inscritos en 1991 y hoy no es accesible para la mayoria de los residentes. Los adultos mayores y personas con discapacidades en Florida tienen tres vias principales para reducir los costos de medicamentos recetados en 2026: Medicare Extra Help (el Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos federal), los Programas de Ahorro de Medicare (QMB, SLMB y QI), y el programa de descuento Florida Rx Card. Los consejeros de Florida SHINE al 1-800-963-5337 ofrecen ayuda gratuita e imparcial para navegar todas las opciones.

h1.en: Florida Prescription Drug Assistance Programs (2026): SPAP, Extra Help, and More
h1.es: Programas de Asistencia para Medicamentos en Florida (2026): SPAP, Extra Help y Mas

introParagraphs.en: Florida is home to more than 4 million Medicare beneficiaries, many of whom face high prescription drug costs. Florida does not operate an active State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program (SPAP) in 2026 because the state's legacy SPAP, run through the Florida Comprehensive Health Association (FCHA), has been closed to new enrollees since 1991. That means Florida residents cannot access a state-funded drug subsidy program the way residents of New Jersey (PAAD), Pennsylvania (PACE), or New York (EPIC) can.
introParagraphs.es: Florida es hogar de mas de 4 millones de beneficiarios de Medicare, muchos de los cuales enfrentan altos costos de medicamentos recetados. Florida no opera un Programa Estatal de Asistencia Farmaceutica (SPAP) activo en 2026 porque el SPAP heredado del estado, administrado a traves de la Asociacion de Salud Integral de Florida (FCHA), ha estado cerrado para nuevos inscritos desde 1991.

introParagraphs.en: Florida residents do have access to three strong federal and state-backed programs that collectively cover the same ground: Medicare Extra Help (the Low Income Subsidy or LIS), the four Medicare Savings Programs (QMB, SLMB, QI, and QDWI), and the Florida Rx Card discount program available to all state residents regardless of income. This guide covers each program's 2026 income limits, what it covers, and how to apply through Florida's SHINE program or directly through federal agencies.
introParagraphs.es: Los residentes de Florida tienen acceso a tres solidos programas federales y estatales que cubren el mismo terreno: Medicare Extra Help (el Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos o LIS), los cuatro Programas de Ahorro de Medicare (QMB, SLMB, QI y QDWI), y el programa de descuento Florida Rx Card disponible para todos los residentes del estado independientemente de sus ingresos.

footnote.en: Extra Help income limits are set at 150% of the Federal Poverty Level (FPL). The Social Security Administration uses the prior calendar year's FPL guidelines when setting Extra Help limits, so 2026 Extra Help limits are based on 2025 FPL. Household sizes above 2 are calculated by adding $8,250 per additional person (150% of the 2025 FPL increment of $5,500 per person). Resource limits: $18,090 for individuals and $36,100 for couples (2026). Florida does not add a state supplement above these federal thresholds.
footnote.es: Los limites de ingresos de Extra Help se establecen en el 150% del Nivel de Pobreza Federal (FPL). La Administracion del Seguro Social usa las guias de pobreza del ano calendario anterior al establecer los limites de Extra Help, por lo que los limites 2026 se basan en el FPL de 2025. Limites de recursos: $18,090 para individuos y $36,100 para parejas (2026). Florida no agrega un suplemento estatal por encima de estos umbrales federales.

numberedSteps.en: Step 1: Check whether you are automatically enrolled. Florida residents who receive full Medicaid, Supplemental Security Income (SSI), or are enrolled in a Medicare Savings Program (QMB, SLMB, or QI) are automatically enrolled in Medicare Extra Help. You do not need to apply separately. Look for a letter from the Social Security Administration confirming your enrollment.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 1: Verifique si esta inscrito automaticamente. Los residentes de Florida que reciben Medicaid completo, Ingreso de Seguridad Suplemental (SSI) o estan inscritos en un Programa de Ahorro de Medicare (QMB, SLMB o QI) son inscritos automaticamente en Medicare Extra Help. No necesita solicitar por separado. Busque una carta de la Administracion del Seguro Social confirmando su inscripcion.

numberedSteps.en: Step 2: Apply for Medicare Extra Help online at ssa.gov/medicare/part-d-extra-help or call SSA at 1-800-772-1213. The SSA-1020 form takes roughly 20 minutes to complete. You will need your Social Security number, income information, and asset estimates. Decisions typically arrive within 2 to 4 weeks.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 2: Solicite Medicare Extra Help en linea en ssa.gov/medicare/part-d-extra-help o llame a la SSA al 1-800-772-1213. El formulario SSA-1020 tarda aproximadamente 20 minutos en completarse. Necesitara su numero de Seguro Social, informacion de ingresos y estimados de activos. Las decisiones suelen llegar en 2 a 4 semanas.

numberedSteps.en: Step 3: Apply for a Medicare Savings Program if you need help with Part B premiums or cost-sharing. Florida MSP applications go through the Florida Department of Children and Families (DCF) via ACCESS Florida at myflorida.com/accessflorida or by calling 1-866-762-2237. MSP enrollment automatically triggers Extra Help enrollment.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 3: Solicite un Programa de Ahorro de Medicare si necesita ayuda con las primas de la Parte B o los costos compartidos. Las solicitudes de MSP de Florida se tramitan a traves del Departamento de Ninos y Familias de Florida (DCF) en ACCESS Florida en myflorida.com/accessflorida o llamando al 1-866-762-2237. La inscripcion en MSP activa automaticamente la inscripcion en Extra Help.

numberedSteps.en: Step 4: Contact Florida SHINE for free counseling. Florida SHINE (Serving Health Insurance Needs of Elders) offers no-cost, one-on-one counseling from trained volunteers across Florida. SHINE counselors can compare your Part D plan options, explain how Extra Help reduces costs, and identify any additional assistance programs you may qualify for. Call 1-800-963-5337 or find a local SHINE site at floridashine.org.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 4: Comuniquese con Florida SHINE para consejeria gratuita. Florida SHINE ofrece consejeria individual sin costo de voluntarios capacitados en todo Florida. Los consejeros de SHINE pueden comparar sus opciones de Plan D, explicar como Extra Help reduce los costos e identificar otros programas de asistencia para los que podria calificar. Llame al 1-800-963-5337 o encuentre un sitio local de SHINE en floridashine.org.

numberedSteps.en: Step 5: Pick up your free Florida Rx Card if you need discounts on drugs not covered by your plan or before Medicare coverage kicks in. The Florida Rx Card is free, requires no income proof, and works at most pharmacies statewide. It provides discounts up to 80% on brand and generic drugs. Download it at floridashine.org or call (850) 764-1919.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 5: Obtenga su Florida Rx Card gratuita si necesita descuentos en medicamentos no cubiertos por su plan o antes de que entre en vigor la cobertura de Medicare. La Florida Rx Card es gratuita, no requiere comprobante de ingresos y funciona en la mayoria de las farmacias del estado. Proporciona descuentos de hasta el 80% en medicamentos de marca y genericos. Descarguela en floridashine.org o llame al (850) 764-1919.

commonDenialReasons.en: Income above the program threshold: Extra Help requires annual income at or below $23,475 for individuals (2026) or $31,725 for couples. Income from Social Security, pensions, wages, and interest all count.
commonDenialReasons.es: Ingresos por encima del umbral del programa: Extra Help requiere ingresos anuales iguales o inferiores a $23,475 para personas (2026) o $31,725 para parejas. Los ingresos del Seguro Social, pensiones, salarios e intereses cuentan.

commonDenialReasons.en: Resources above the asset limit: Extra Help also has a resource limit of $18,090 for individuals and $36,100 for couples in 2026. Your home, one car, life insurance with face value under $1,500, and a $1,500 burial fund are excluded from resources.
commonDenialReasons.es: Recursos por encima del limite de activos: Extra Help tambien tiene un limite de recursos de $18,090 para personas y $36,100 para parejas en 2026. Su casa, un auto, seguro de vida con valor nominal inferior a $1,500 y un fondo funerario de $1,500 estan excluidos.

commonDenialReasons.en: Not enrolled in Medicare Part D: Extra Help only applies when you are enrolled in a Medicare Part D drug plan. You must enroll in a standalone Part D plan or a Medicare Advantage plan with drug coverage (MA-PD) before benefits apply.
commonDenialReasons.es: No inscrito en Medicare Parte D: Extra Help solo aplica cuando esta inscrito en un plan de medicamentos Medicare Parte D. Debe inscribirse en un plan Parte D independiente o en un plan Medicare Advantage con cobertura de medicamentos (MA-PD).

commonDenialReasons.en: Missing or incomplete documentation: The SSA-1020 form requires accurate income and resource figures. Incomplete submissions delay processing. Florida SHINE counselors can review your form before submission.
commonDenialReasons.es: Documentacion faltante o incompleta: El formulario SSA-1020 requiere cifras precisas de ingresos y recursos. Las presentaciones incompletas retrasan el procesamiento. Los consejeros de Florida SHINE pueden revisar su formulario antes de presentarlo.

commonDenialReasons.en: Not residing in Florida: MSP benefits through Florida Medicaid require Florida residency. If you have moved, update your address with Social Security and the Florida DCF before applying.
commonDenialReasons.es: No residir en Florida: Los beneficios del MSP a traves de Florida Medicaid requieren residencia en Florida. Si se mudo, actualice su direccion con el Seguro Social y el DCF de Florida antes de solicitar.

deadline.en: Medicare Extra Help and Medicare Savings Programs: year-round enrollment, no open enrollment window. Florida Rx Card: no enrollment period, download at any time.
deadline.es: Medicare Extra Help y Programas de Ahorro de Medicare: inscripcion durante todo el ano, sin ventana de inscripcion abierta. Florida Rx Card: sin periodo de inscripcion, descargue en cualquier momento.

heading.en: Quick Answer: Florida's SPAP Status in 2026
heading.es: Respuesta rapida: Estado del SPAP de Florida en 2026

paragraphs.en: It depends on what you need. Florida does not have an active State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program in 2026. The Florida Comprehensive Health Association (FCHA), which administered the state's legacy SPAP, closed to new enrollees in 1991 and has not reopened. Florida residents seeking prescription drug cost relief must use federal programs (Medicare Extra Help and Medicare Savings Programs) or the statewide Florida Rx Card discount program.
paragraphs.es: Depende de lo que necesite. Florida no tiene un Programa Estatal de Asistencia Farmaceutica activo en 2026. La Asociacion de Salud Integral de Florida (FCHA), que administraba el SPAP heredado del estado, cerro para nuevos inscritos en 1991 y no ha reabierto. Los residentes de Florida que buscan reducir los costos de medicamentos recetados deben usar programas federales (Medicare Extra Help y Programas de Ahorro de Medicare) o el programa de descuento Florida Rx Card.

heading.en: What Florida's SPAP Was and Why It Is No Longer Available
heading.es: Que era el SPAP de Florida y por que ya no esta disponible

paragraphs.en: Florida established a State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program through the Florida Comprehensive Health Association, which was originally a high-risk pool for uninsurable residents. The FCHA closed its doors to new members in 1991, making Florida one of the states without an active SPAP. Roughly half of all U.S. states operate active SPAPs today, including New Jersey (Pharmaceutical Assistance to the Aged and Disabled, or PAAD), Pennsylvania (PACE/PACENET), New York (EPIC), and Connecticut (ConnPACE). Florida is not among them.
paragraphs.es: Florida establecio un Programa Estatal de Asistencia Farmaceutica a traves de la Asociacion de Salud Integral de Florida, que originalmente era un fondo de alto riesgo para residentes que no podian asegurarse. La FCHA cerro sus puertas a nuevos miembros en 1991, convirtiendo a Florida en uno de los estados sin un SPAP activo. Aproximadamente la mitad de todos los estados de EE.UU. operan SPAPs activos hoy, incluyendo Nueva Jersey (PAAD), Pennsylvania (PACE/PACENET), Nueva York (EPIC) y Connecticut (ConnPACE). Florida no se encuentra entre ellos.

paragraphs.en: Florida has periodically discussed reinstating a pharmaceutical assistance program for seniors, but as of June 2026 no new state-funded SPAP has been authorized by the Florida Legislature. Residents who enrolled in the FCHA before 1991 may retain legacy coverage; anyone who did not enroll before the closure cannot access the program.
paragraphs.es: Florida ha discutido periodicamente restablecer un programa de asistencia farmaceutica para adultos mayores, pero a partir de junio de 2026 la Legislatura de Florida no ha autorizado ningun nuevo SPAP financiado por el estado. Los residentes que se inscribieron en la FCHA antes de 1991 pueden conservar la cobertura heredada; cualquiera que no se haya inscrito antes del cierre no puede acceder al programa.

heading.en: Medicare Extra Help (Low Income Subsidy) in Florida: 2026 Income Limits
heading.es: Medicare Extra Help (Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos) en Florida: limites de ingresos 2026

paragraphs.en: Medicare Extra Help, also called the Low Income Subsidy (LIS), is the primary prescription drug assistance program available to Florida Medicare beneficiaries in 2026. Extra Help is administered by the Social Security Administration and is available in all 50 states, including Florida. Qualifying Florida residents pay no Part D premium (for benchmark plans), no Part D deductible, and capped copays of $5.10 per generic drug and $12.65 per brand-name drug in 2026. Once annual out-of-pocket spending reaches $2,100 (the 2026 Part D catastrophic threshold), every covered drug is free for the rest of the year. Extra Help does not use MAGI (Modified Adjusted Gross Income) rules the way Medicaid does; instead, SSA counts most income sources but excludes certain items such as food assistance and housing subsidies.
paragraphs.es: Medicare Extra Help, tambien llamado Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos (LIS), es el principal programa de asistencia para medicamentos disponible para los beneficiarios de Medicare en Florida en 2026. Extra Help es administrado por la Administracion del Seguro Social y esta disponible en los 50 estados, incluido Florida. Los residentes de Florida que califican no pagan prima de la Parte D (para planes de referencia), sin deducible de la Parte D, y copagos limitados de $5.10 por medicamento generico y $12.65 por medicamento de marca en 2026.

paragraphs.en: Florida Medicare beneficiaries qualify for Extra Help if household income is at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Level and resources (savings, investments) are below the 2026 asset caps. The Social Security Administration uses the prior year's poverty guidelines to set Extra Help thresholds, so 2026 Extra Help limits are based on 2025 FPL. For an individual, the income limit is $23,475 per year ($1,956 per month) and for a couple it is $31,725 per year ($2,644 per month). Resources are capped at $18,090 for individuals and $36,100 for couples. Your home, one vehicle, personal belongings, and a $1,500 burial set-aside do not count toward the resource limit. Unlike Medicaid, Extra Help does not scale income limits by full family size beyond a two-person household, so an individual and a married couple are the two primary thresholds regardless of additional household members.
paragraphs.es: Los beneficiarios de Medicare en Florida califican para Extra Help si el ingreso del hogar es igual o inferior al 150% del Nivel de Pobreza Federal y los recursos (ahorros, inversiones) estan por debajo de los limites de activos 2026. La SSA usa las guias de pobreza del ano anterior para establecer los umbrales de Extra Help, por lo que los limites 2026 se basan en el FPL de 2025. Para un individuo, el limite de ingresos es $23,475 por ano ($1,956 por mes) y para una pareja es $31,725 por ano ($2,644 por mes).

paragraphs.en: Florida has one of the highest LIS enrollment populations in the country, with more than 1 million residents receiving Extra Help. About 1 in 4 Part D enrollees in Florida qualifies automatically because they receive full Medicaid or SSI. The remaining eligible residents must apply directly through the Social Security Administration using the SSA-1020 form, available online at ssa.gov or at any local Social Security office. Florida SHINE counselors at 1-800-963-5337 can complete the application with you at no cost.
paragraphs.es: Florida tiene una de las mayores poblaciones de inscritos en LIS del pais, con mas de 1 millon de residentes que reciben Extra Help. Aproximadamente 1 de cada 4 inscritos en la Parte D en Florida califica automaticamente porque recibe Medicaid completo o SSI. Los demas residentes elegibles deben solicitar directamente a traves de la Administracion del Seguro Social usando el formulario SSA-1020, disponible en linea en ssa.gov o en cualquier oficina local del Seguro Social.

heading.en: Florida Medicare Savings Programs (QMB, SLMB, QI, and QDWI): 2026 Income Limits
heading.es: Programas de Ahorro de Medicare de Florida (QMB, SLMB, QI y QDWI): limites de ingresos 2026

paragraphs.en: Florida administers four Medicare Savings Programs (MSPs) through the Florida Agency for Health Care Administration (AHCA) and the Department of Children and Families (DCF). These programs pay Medicare premiums and cost-sharing for enrollees whose income falls below specific thresholds. Importantly, enrollment in any MSP automatically qualifies you for Medicare Extra Help, making the MSP application a two-for-one benefit.
paragraphs.es: Florida administra cuatro Programas de Ahorro de Medicare (MSPs) a traves de la Agencia de Administracion de Atencion Medica de Florida (AHCA) y el Departamento de Ninos y Familias (DCF). Estos programas pagan las primas de Medicare y los costos compartidos para los inscritos cuyos ingresos caen por debajo de umbrales especificos. La inscripcion en cualquier MSP califica automaticamente para Medicare Extra Help.

paragraphs.en: Florida's 2026 MSP income limits (monthly figures include the standard $20 general income disregard): Qualified Medicare Beneficiary (QMB) covers the full scope of Medicare cost-sharing, including Part A and Part B premiums, deductibles, and copays, for individuals with income at or below $1,350 per month and couples at or below $1,824 per month. Specified Low-Income Medicare Beneficiary (SLMB) covers the Part B premium of $202.90 per month in 2026 for individuals under $1,616 per month and couples under $2,184 per month. Qualifying Individual (QI) also covers the Part B premium for individuals below $1,816 per month and couples below $2,455 per month, but QI slots are limited and awarded first-come, first-served each federal fiscal year. Qualified Disabled and Working Individual (QDWI) assists with the Part A premium for working people with disabilities; income limits are 200% FPL. All MSPs use an asset limit of $9,950 for individuals and $14,910 for couples in 2026.
paragraphs.es: Los limites de ingresos mensuales del MSP de Florida para 2026 (incluyen el descuento general de $20): QMB cubre la gama completa de costos compartidos de Medicare para individuos con ingresos iguales o inferiores a $1,350 por mes y parejas iguales o inferiores a $1,824 por mes. SLMB cubre la prima de la Parte B de $202.90 por mes en 2026 para individuos por debajo de $1,616 por mes y parejas por debajo de $2,184 por mes. QI tambien cubre la prima de la Parte B para individuos por debajo de $1,816 por mes y parejas por debajo de $2,455 por mes, pero los lugares de QI son limitados y se otorgan por orden de llegada cada ano fiscal federal.

heading.en: Is Florida a Medicaid Expansion State?
heading.es: Es Florida un estado de expansion de Medicaid?

paragraphs.en: Florida has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA. Florida is one of 10 states (along with Alabama, Georgia, Kansas, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Wisconsin, and Wyoming) that have not extended Medicaid eligibility to adults up to 138% of the Federal Poverty Level. This matters directly to prescription drug assistance because Florida adults ages 19 to 64 without disabilities or dependent children are generally not eligible for Florida Medicaid, regardless of income. They cannot qualify for full Medicaid, which would automatically trigger Extra Help enrollment.
paragraphs.es: Florida no ha expandido Medicaid bajo la ACA. Florida es uno de los 10 estados (junto con Alabama, Georgia, Kansas, Misisipi, Carolina del Sur, Tennessee, Texas, Wisconsin y Wyoming) que no han extendido la elegibilidad de Medicaid a adultos hasta el 138% del Nivel de Pobreza Federal. Esto importa directamente para la asistencia de medicamentos porque los adultos de Florida de 19 a 64 anos sin discapacidades o hijos dependientes generalmente no son elegibles para Medicaid de Florida, independientemente de sus ingresos.

paragraphs.en: Florida does operate a Medically Needy program, which allows some residents with incomes above the standard Medicaid threshold to qualify by spending down medical expenses to a monthly cost-sharing threshold. Prescription drug costs that exceed a resident's share of cost in a given month can then be covered by Florida Medicaid under the Medically Needy pathway. Seniors (age 65 and over) and people with disabilities follow separate, somewhat less restrictive Florida Medicaid rules and may qualify even without expansion. Pregnant women qualify up to 196% FPL and children up to 210% FPL under Florida's CHIP and KidCare programs.
paragraphs.es: Florida opera un programa Medicamente Necesitado, que permite que algunos residentes con ingresos superiores al umbral estandar de Medicaid califiquen al gastar en gastos medicos hasta un umbral mensual de costo compartido. Los adultos mayores (65 anos o mas) y las personas con discapacidades siguen reglas de Florida Medicaid separadas y algo menos restrictivas y pueden calificar incluso sin expansion.

heading.en: Florida Rx Card: The No-Income-Test Option Available to All Florida Residents
heading.es: Florida Rx Card: la opcion sin requisito de ingresos disponible para todos los residentes de Florida

paragraphs.en: Florida launched the Florida Rx Card statewide discount program in August 2007 as a free tool available to every Florida resident, regardless of income, insurance status, or age. The Florida Rx Card provides negotiated discounts of up to 80% on brand and generic prescription drugs at participating pharmacies throughout Florida. The card is free to download or print from the Florida SHINE website at floridashine.org, and no application, income documentation, or enrollment period is required.
paragraphs.es: Florida lanzo el programa de descuento estatal Florida Rx Card en agosto de 2007 como una herramienta gratuita disponible para todos los residentes de Florida, independientemente de sus ingresos, estado de seguro o edad. La Florida Rx Card proporciona descuentos negociados de hasta el 80% en medicamentos recetados de marca y genericos en farmacias participantes en todo Florida.

paragraphs.en: Florida residents typically use the Rx Card for three purposes: filling prescriptions for drugs not covered by their current insurance plan, reducing costs during a coverage gap or waiting period, or accessing discounted pricing when the card beats their plan copay for a specific drug. The Florida Rx Card works alongside, not instead of, Medicare Extra Help or Medicare Savings Programs. Florida SHINE encourages all residents to keep an Rx Card on hand even if they have other coverage.
paragraphs.es: Los residentes de Florida normalmente usan la Rx Card para tres propositos: surtir recetas de medicamentos no cubiertos por su plan de seguro actual, reducir costos durante una brecha de cobertura o periodo de espera, o acceder a precios con descuento cuando la tarjeta supera el copago de su plan para un medicamento especifico.

heading.en: How to Apply for Florida Rx Assistance Programs
heading.es: Como solicitar los programas de asistencia de Rx de Florida

paragraphs.en: Florida residents pursuing prescription drug assistance have two parallel tracks: the federal track (Extra Help and MSPs) and the state discount track (Florida Rx Card). Both tracks are available simultaneously. Florida SHINE counselors coordinate both and can help residents identify which programs will provide the greatest savings based on their specific drug list and pharmacy.
paragraphs.es: Los residentes de Florida que buscan asistencia para medicamentos recetados tienen dos vias paralelas: la via federal (Extra Help y MSPs) y la via de descuento estatal (Florida Rx Card). Ambas vias estan disponibles simultaneamente. Los consejeros de Florida SHINE coordinan ambas y pueden ayudar a los residentes a identificar que programas ofreceran el mayor ahorro segun su lista especifica de medicamentos y farmacia.

heading.en: Documents Needed and Common Denial Reasons
heading.es: Documentos necesarios y razones comunes de denegacion

paragraphs.en: Florida Extra Help and MSP applications require standard income and resource documentation. The most common reason Florida residents are denied Extra Help is income slightly above the $23,475 individual or $31,725 couple threshold. However, SSA excludes certain income sources: the value of your home, household goods, and one car are excluded from resources; earned income tax credit payments, food assistance benefits, and most housing assistance do not count as income. Residents whose applications are denied have 60 days to request reconsideration from the SSA.
paragraphs.es: Las solicitudes de Extra Help y MSP de Florida requieren documentacion estandar de ingresos y recursos. La razon mas comun por la que los residentes de Florida son rechazados para Extra Help es un ingreso ligeramente superior al umbral de $23,475 para individuos o $31,725 para parejas. Sin embargo, la SSA excluye ciertas fuentes de ingresos. Los residentes cuyas solicitudes son denegadas tienen 60 dias para solicitar reconsideracion a la SSA.

list.en: Income over the Extra Help threshold ($23,475 individual/$31,725 couple in 2026): the most common denial reason
list.es: Ingresos superiores al umbral de Extra Help ($23,475 persona/$31,725 pareja en 2026): la razon de denegacion mas comun

list.en: Resources over $18,090 (individual) or $36,100 (couple): check whether all excluded items have been properly removed from your resource count
list.es: Recursos superiores a $18,090 (individual) o $36,100 (pareja): verifique que todos los elementos excluidos se hayan eliminado correctamente de su conteo de recursos

list.en: Not enrolled in a Medicare Part D plan: Extra Help requires active Part D enrollment to apply benefits
list.es: No inscrito en un plan Medicare Parte D: Extra Help requiere inscripcion activa en la Parte D para aplicar los beneficios

list.en: Missing or incorrect documentation: provide complete bank statements, Social Security award letters, and any pension or annuity statements
list.es: Documentacion faltante o incorrecta: proporcione estados bancarios completos, cartas de adjudicacion del Seguro Social y cualquier estado de pension o anualidad

list.en: Florida residency not verifiable: submit a recent utility bill, lease, or official government correspondence with your Florida address
list.es: Residencia en Florida no verificable: presente una factura de servicios publicos reciente, contrato de arrendamiento o correspondencia oficial del gobierno con su direccion de Florida

en.question: Does Florida have a State Pharmaceutical Assistance Program (SPAP) in 2026?
en.answer: No active SPAP exists for new applicants. Florida's legacy SPAP, run through the Florida Comprehensive Health Association, closed to new enrollees in 1991. Florida residents must use Medicare Extra Help (income at or below $23,475/year for individuals in 2026), Medicare Savings Programs, or the free Florida Rx Card discount program.

en.question: What is the income limit for Medicare Extra Help in Florida in 2026?
en.answer: The 2026 Extra Help income limit in Florida is $23,475 per year ($1,956 per month) for individuals and $31,725 per year ($2,644 per month) for couples living together. These limits equal 150% of the 2025 Federal Poverty Level. Resource limits are $18,090 for individuals and $36,100 for couples. Your home and one car do not count toward resources.

en.question: What does Medicare Extra Help cover for Florida residents in 2026?
en.answer: Medicare Extra Help eliminates the Part D deductible entirely, caps copays at $5.10 per generic drug and $12.65 per brand-name drug in 2026, and pays the Part D premium up to the regional benchmark amount. Once total out-of-pocket drug spending reaches $2,100 in 2026 (the Part D catastrophic threshold), all covered drugs are free for the rest of the plan year.

en.question: What is the Florida Rx Card and who can use it?
en.answer: The Florida Rx Card is a free statewide prescription discount program launched in 2007 by the Florida Department of Elder Affairs and SHINE. Any Florida resident can use it regardless of income, age, or insurance status. The card provides discounts up to 80% at participating pharmacies. Download it free at floridashine.org or call (850) 764-1919.

en.question: What are the Medicare Savings Program income limits in Florida for 2026?
en.answer: Florida's 2026 MSP monthly income limits (including the $20 income disregard): QMB at $1,350/month for individuals and $1,824/month for couples; SLMB at $1,616/month and $2,184/month; QI at $1,816/month and $2,455/month. All programs also apply a resource limit of $9,950 for individuals and $14,910 for couples. Apply through Florida ACCESS at myflorida.com/accessflorida or call 1-866-762-2237.

en.question: Is Florida a Medicaid expansion state?
en.answer: No. Florida has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA and remains one of 10 non-expansion states as of 2026. Working-age adults without disabilities or dependent children generally cannot qualify for Florida Medicaid regardless of income. This means most working-age Florida adults cannot get automatic Extra Help through full Medicaid enrollment and must apply separately through the SSA.

en.question: How does SHINE help Florida residents with prescription drug costs?
en.answer: Florida SHINE (Serving Health Insurance Needs of Elders) is a free Medicare counseling service funded by the Florida Department of Elder Affairs. SHINE counselors are trained volunteers who can compare Part D plans, complete Extra Help and MSP applications with you, and identify manufacturer patient assistance programs for specific drugs. Call SHINE at 1-800-963-5337 or find a local counselor at floridashine.org.

en.question: What if my income is too high for Extra Help but I still cannot afford my medications?
en.answer: Florida residents above the Extra Help threshold have several options. Manufacturer patient assistance programs (PAPs) provide free or reduced-cost brand-name drugs directly from pharmaceutical companies for low-to-moderate income patients; NeedyMeds at needymeds.org lists current PAPs. The Florida Rx Card provides discounts at pharmacies regardless of income. Medicare Advantage plans with enhanced drug benefits may offer lower copays than standard Part D. Florida SHINE at 1-800-963-5337 can review all options against your specific drug list.

es.question: Tiene Florida un Programa Estatal de Asistencia Farmaceutica (SPAP) en 2026?
es.answer: No existe un SPAP activo para nuevos solicitantes. El SPAP heredado de Florida, administrado a traves de la Asociacion de Salud Integral de Florida, cerro para nuevos inscritos en 1991. Los residentes de Florida deben usar Medicare Extra Help (ingresos iguales o inferiores a $23,475/ano para personas en 2026), los Programas de Ahorro de Medicare o el programa de descuento gratuito Florida Rx Card.

es.question: Cual es el limite de ingresos para Medicare Extra Help en Florida en 2026?
es.answer: El limite de ingresos de Extra Help 2026 en Florida es $23,475 por ano ($1,956 por mes) para personas y $31,725 por ano ($2,644 por mes) para parejas que viven juntas. Estos limites equivalen al 150% del Nivel de Pobreza Federal de 2025. Los limites de recursos son $18,090 para personas y $36,100 para parejas. Su casa y un auto no cuentan como recursos.

es.question: Que cubre Medicare Extra Help para los residentes de Florida en 2026?
es.answer: Medicare Extra Help elimina completamente el deducible de la Parte D, limita los copagos a $5.10 por medicamento generico y $12.65 por medicamento de marca en 2026, y paga la prima de la Parte D hasta el monto de referencia regional. Una vez que el gasto total de bolsillo en medicamentos alcanza $2,100 en 2026, todos los medicamentos cubiertos son gratuitos por el resto del ano del plan.

es.question: Que es la Florida Rx Card y quien puede usarla?
es.answer: La Florida Rx Card es un programa gratuito de descuento para medicamentos recetados lanzado en 2007 por el Departamento de Asuntos de Adultos Mayores de Florida y SHINE. Cualquier residente de Florida puede usarla independientemente de sus ingresos, edad o estado de seguro. La tarjeta proporciona descuentos de hasta el 80% en farmacias participantes. Descarguela gratis en floridashine.org o llame al (850) 764-1919.

es.question: Cuales son los limites de ingresos del Programa de Ahorro de Medicare en Florida para 2026?
es.answer: Los limites mensuales de ingresos del MSP de Florida para 2026 (incluyen el descuento de $20): QMB en $1,350/mes para personas y $1,824/mes para parejas; SLMB en $1,616/mes y $2,184/mes; QI en $1,816/mes y $2,455/mes. Todos los programas tambien aplican un limite de recursos de $9,950 para personas y $14,910 para parejas. Solicite a traves de ACCESS Florida en myflorida.com/accessflorida o llame al 1-866-762-2237.

es.question: Es Florida un estado de expansion de Medicaid?
es.answer: No. Florida no ha expandido Medicaid bajo la ACA y sigue siendo uno de los 10 estados sin expansion a partir de 2026. Los adultos en edad de trabajar sin discapacidades o hijos dependientes generalmente no pueden calificar para Medicaid de Florida independientemente de sus ingresos. Esto significa que la mayoria de los adultos de Florida en edad de trabajar no pueden obtener Extra Help automatico a traves de la inscripcion en Medicaid completo y deben solicitar por separado a traves de la SSA.

es.question: Como ayuda SHINE a los residentes de Florida con los costos de medicamentos?
es.answer: Florida SHINE (Serving Health Insurance Needs of Elders) es un servicio gratuito de asesoria de Medicare financiado por el Departamento de Asuntos de Adultos Mayores de Florida. Los consejeros de SHINE son voluntarios capacitados que pueden comparar planes de la Parte D, completar solicitudes de Extra Help y MSP con usted, e identificar programas de asistencia de fabricantes para medicamentos especificos. Llame a SHINE al 1-800-963-5337 o encuentre un consejero local en floridashine.org.

es.question: Que pasa si mis ingresos son demasiado altos para Extra Help pero aun no puedo pagar mis medicamentos?
es.answer: Los residentes de Florida por encima del umbral de Extra Help tienen varias opciones. Los programas de asistencia de pacientes (PAPs) de fabricantes proporcionan medicamentos de marca gratuitos o a costo reducido directamente de companias farmaceuticas; NeedyMeds en needymeds.org enumera los PAPs actuales. La Florida Rx Card proporciona descuentos en farmacias independientemente de los ingresos. Los planes Medicare Advantage con beneficios de medicamentos mejorados pueden ofrecer copagos mas bajos que la Parte D estandar. Florida SHINE al 1-800-963-5337 puede revisar todas las opciones contra su lista especifica de medicamentos.
